Close Gitasaleh Virast's Diary ای کسانی که در ویرایش کردن تنها واگردانی بلدند Posted by Gitasaleh Virast on 6 July 2026 in Persian (فارسی) . معبر یا گره یا ساختمان یا محیطی که نام روز باشد نباید به نام قبلی واگردانی شود. غیر قابل واگردانی است. همین معبر خشایار کریمیان(بیست و سوم) که یک کاربر، به نام قبلی برگرداند با وجود اینکه نام بیست و سوم در یک برچسب دیگر یاد شده بود. هم این ویرایشگر و هم ویرایشگرهای دیگر توجه فرمایند که هر تغییر نام یا کدگذاری که شهرداری می‌کند را مورد توجه قرار بگیرند و نگذارند به گردن گیتاصالح ویراست (من) بیفتد. اطلاعات شهرداری‌ها، دهیاری‌ها و وزارت راه و شهرسازی، قابل واگردانی نیستند. Discussion Comment from Gitasaleh Virast on 9 July 2026 at 17:37 وقتی معبر تگ مسکونی (رزیدنتال) می‌گیرد، کدگذاری بطور خودکار حذف می‌شود. تقصیر شخص نیست آن فرد باید دوباره کدگذاری بگذارد. Jackyenjoyphotography via Getty Images In 2020, humans hunkered down amid the Covid-19 pandemic, contributing to an unprecedented 7 percent decrease in global fossil fuel emissions , according to the Global Carbon Project, an international collaboration that releases annual reports on emissions trends. For the first time since then, emissions are expected to fall again, although to a lesser degree. Global Carbon Project researchers predict that in 2026, countries will have emitted 42.1 billion U.S. tons of planet-warming carbon dioxide, a 0.4 percent decrease compared with the previous year. That’s partly because of growing solar and wind power, but also a surge in oil prices and supply chain issues sparked by the United States-Israel war with Iran. The three cases in the United States were previously reported, and there have been no cases reported in the United States since mid-February 2025. The 11 deaths occurred in Cambodia (8), India (2), and Mexico (1). All of these infections were in people with likely or reported direct contact with poultry and/or wild birds. The brightly hued sandstone provides a stunning canvas for the area’s famously beautiful rock art, and the desert provides critical habitat. pages.description: The tech giant aims to use the near-constant sunlight available in low-Earth orbit to power data centers. The experimental satellite, launched October 1, holds four computer chips that can run Google’s Gemini A.I. for 15 minutes at a time
pages.text: Google Wants to Send Data Centers to Space—and Just Launched an Experimental Satellite to Test Whether Its Ambitious Plan Will Work Skip to main content The view from low-Earth orbit NASA On October 1, Google sent a refrigerator-size test satellite to low-Earth orbit, taking a major step in its goal of putting data centers in space. The tech giant aims to put the infrastructure to run its artificial intelligence models there so the systems can be powered by sunlight. Although far from achieving this goal, the company’s current test—part of Project Suncatcher —will assess how Google’s hardware performs in the harsh conditions of space. “This first launch is about seeing what works, identifying points of failure and applying those findings to future missions,” writes Travis Beals , Google’s senior director of paradigms of intelligence and head of Project Suncatcher, in a September 24 statement . The experimental satellite, which hitched a ride on a SpaceX rocket, was developed in partnership with the satellite imagery company Planet. It’s carrying four custom chips called tensor processing units (TPUs), which have the computing power of one server in a data center, report Kate Conger and Cade Metz for the New York Times . (The largest data centers contain more than one million servers .) The TPU chips will run for 15-minute stretches, during which they can run Google’s Gemini A.I. and process short queries. Gracie's Corner: Tiny Desk Concert November 16, 2026 5:00 AM ET By Alanté Serene Credit: Photo: Lexy Beale/NPR The first time I heard a Gracie's Corner song, it stopped me in my tracks. The beat cranked so hard that I rushed over to see what my niece was watching. "This can't be for toddlers," I thought. Turns out I was being introduced to a platform that is educational, empowering and, yes, age-appropriate. It's not often that an animated series makes music that grown folks actually enjoy, but this family production out of Houston, Texas, has changed the way so many hear nursery rhymes. Graceyn Hollingsworth, the inspiration and voice behind Gracie, came to the Tiny Desk properly prepped. The series was created with Graceyn's parents, Dr. Javoris Hollingsworth and Dr. Arlene Gordon-Hollingsworth, when they noticed a lack of Black representation in children's programming. Both parents watched proudly from the Tiny Desk sidelines as 13-year-old Graceyn led the band through a high-energy, beat-heavy set that had kids and adults dancing and singing along. Underwood, 25, joined London-based PR agency Fight or Flight in November last year, in the new role of "AI associate" after completing a degree and then a masters in marketing. She's part of a recently established, dedicated AI team that has built around 30 AI agents. Specific tasks include industry research, client reporting, media interview preparation, helping clients create clearer briefs, and image generation. pages.text: Grand Slam of Darts 2026: Luke Littler shocked by Jermaine Wattimena in round two - BBC Sport Image source, Getty Images Image caption, Luke Littler's title defence is over despite an average of 101.38 against Jermaine Wattimena By Sam Drury BBC Sport journalist Published 3 hours ago Defending champion Luke Littler suffered a shock early exit at the Grand Slam of Darts after a stunning display from Jermaine Wattimena. Grid Cybersecurity and Communications Our nation's energy system is heavily dependent on information networks for operational reliability. Facing more dynamic behavior by electric loads at scale, the grid's operators, automated logic and--in the near future--artificial intelligence feeds on increasingly rapid timescales to manage grid assets and maintain stability. At the same time, grid-connected devices are producing and exposing more data than ever before. In fact, the next-generation power grid will be an information network as much as it is an energy network. Increasingly distributed networked grid assets present a broader attack surface for adversaries to exploit. Cyber incidents can interrupt the grid, damage highly specialized equipment, and threaten human health and safety. Modernizing communications and control systems to support end-to-end information security for real-time operations--from the edge of the control center and back--it's essential to ensure the efficient and reliable operation of the electrical power system in a complex and dynamic risk landscape. Grid Modeling The Office of Electricity’s (OE) Advanced Grid Modeling program leads research activities to develop robust model-based solutions for the current and future electric power grid that result in new software and analytical toolsets for operators and planners. The program builds capacity and capability within the electric sector to analyze the electricity delivery system using data, advanced mathematical theory, and high-performance computing to assess the current state of the grid, mitigate reliability risks, and understand future needs. The power system relies upon models to support system operation, planning, and markets. Because the power system is so large and complex, models provide system planners and operators with manageable tools to characterize the past, current, and future system conditions. Grid modeling is a careful balance between getting enough detail in system models and simulations to make decisions while balancing the speed and accuracy of computation. Detailed data about system conditions from new sensing devices has helped researchers better understand how the power grid can evolve to meet 21st Century needs. pages.text: Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame (Gridded EIF) Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame (Gridded EIF) Skip Navigation Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame (Gridded EIF) July 22, 2025 The Gridded Environmental Impacts Frame (Gridded EIF ) is an innovative, privacy-protected experimental dataset derived from the Census Bureau's confidential Environmental Impacts Frame (EIF) microdata. Organized on a fixed 0.01-degree grid, approximately 1.2 square kilometers in North America, the Gridded EIF provides detailed demographic counts by age, sex, race and ethnicity as well as counts of the population by race and ethnicity and household income decile. Additionally, the Gridded EIF makes available exposure data for several key environmental hazards, including air pollution, on the same grid. By making this granular dataset accessible, we empower the research community to conduct advanced spatial analyses that yield deeper insights and surpass the capabilities of traditional aggregated place-based data studies, all while upholding the strictest confidentiality standards. Initial Release Date February 11, 2025 2024 Release Additional annual Gridded EIF files for 2024 are now available. These include the same race-by-age-by-sex and race-by-income tabulations as previous releases, as well as a new dataset tabulating counts of housing units by age and income of householder and home value. Rockstar's action-adventure game releases on Thursday, marking 13 years since the last edition in 2013, which went on to sell nearly 230m copies. The game, which allows players to explore vast open worlds, has been controversial in the past around its depictions of graphic sexual content, violence and drug use. Guernsey Police said adults who wanted to play the game with their children should be careful of being "blinded by nostalgia", and should know the new game was "so much bigger and so much more realistic". Analysts believe GTA VI could be the most expensive ever made - with estimates putting development costs at more than $1bn (£866m). It is set in Leonida, a fictional US state heavily based on Florida, and the game's map is reportedly twice the size of Grand Theft Auto V. Portions of the Gulkana River were designated for its wild character as part of the National Wild and Scenic River system by the Alaska National Interest Lands Conservation Act in 1980. The Gulkana was recognized for its primitive character, abundant fish and wildlife, and its geologic, cultural and recreational values. pages.title: Guppy
pages.text: Guppy Super Guppy Oversize Cargo Transport The transportation of oversized cargo has always been a tremendous problem for logistics planners in government and private industry. The physical limitations of railroad tunnels, narrow roads, low bridges, and power lines make overland shipment of such cargo extremely problematic, if not impossible. NASA's Super Guppy offers a practical and economical solution to these problems. Although there are other aircraft capable of carrying more weight than the Super Guppy, very few come close to its internal dimensions. Boasting an immense cargo area that is 25 feet in diameter and 111 feet long, the Super Guppy can carry items that are virtually impossible to fit inside other cargo aircraft. The Super Guppy has a unique hinged nose that opens 110 degrees, permitting full frontal cargo loading. A control lock and disconnect system at the fuselage break allows the nose to be opened and closed without disrupting the flight or engine control rigging. Cargo loading is simple and efficient. There are fewer handling and shipping fixtures with a minimum of ground support equipment. A system of rails in the cargo compartment is used with either Super Guppy pallets or fixtures designed for specific cargo. Rollers mounted in the rail allow pallets or fixtures to be moved by an electric winch mounted beneath the cargo floor. Automatic hydraulic lock pins in the rail secure the pallet for flight. Guía de pruebas clínicas de dengue 26 de nov. del 2025 English (US) Puntos clave Los médicos deben considerar la posibilidad de dengue en pacientes con fiebre que vivan en áreas con riesgo de dengue o hayan viajado recientemente a estas áreas. Además de la fiebre, los síntomas comunes del dengue incluyen dolor de cabeza intenso, dolor retrorbitario, mialgia y artralgia, erupción macular o maculopapular. Para el diagnóstico de dengue agudo, los médicos deben ordenar una prueba de amplificación de ácidos nucleicos (NAAT) y una prueba de anticuerpos IgM, o una prueba de antígenos NS1 y una prueba de anticuerpos IgM. Si se sospecha dengue, los médicos deben proporcionar el manejo apropiado sin esperar los resultados de las pruebas diagnósticas. pages.text: Gérard Depardieu drops appeal against sexual assault conviction Skip to content Site search Home News Sport Business Technology Health Culture Arts Travel Earth Audio Video Live Documentaries Weather Newsletters Watch Live Gérard Depardieu drops appeal against sexual assault conviction 2 days ago Share Save Add as preferred on Google Hugh Schofield Paris correspondent Reuters Gérard Depardieu appeared at a courthouse in Paris on Monday for his appeal trial that was due to start French film star Gérard Depardieu has dropped his appeal against a conviction for sexual assault , admitting that his behaviour towards women had often been offensive and offering a "deep and sincere" apology. On the day that the appeal was due to start in a Paris court, the 77-year-old actor's unexpected mea culpa marks a dramatic reversal of his previous denials of sexual impropriety. "Justice was pronounced. I was found guilty. I understand and bow to this conviction… I have therefore decided to abandon the appeal," he wrote. It means he is now guilty in law of abusing two women during a film shoot in Paris five years ago, and his 18-month suspended prison term stands. "Victory is ours, and we welcome it with head held high," said one of the two women, named only as Amélie, who was at the court. "There is huge relief because the fight is over. The giant of film has fallen," said the other woman in the case, who is known in court by the false name Sarah. After a goalless first half, the pair were introduced for the start of the second period in a match played in light snow on an artificial pitch. England winger Hemp scored a fortunate opener in the 55th minute when Emma Ostlund's clearance bounced off her and found the bottom corner. City pushed for a second and Mary Fowler put the ball in the net, only for it to be ruled out as Yui Hasegawa was in an offside position in front of home goalkeeper Jennifer Falk. Hemp then hit the post before playing a crucial role in City's second.
